name: ellora-fashion-lifestyle-store
description: Ellora - Fashion & Lifestyle Store HTML Template

scripts.dev:full: concurrently -n storefront,server,admin -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix admin
scripts.prod:full: npm run build:html && concurrently -n storefront,server,admin -c blue,green,magenta "npm run serve:dist" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:admin"
